decision.observation: Car at 1 mph between two large pines, red X lit, all dots dark. The blue tarmac band with puddles and posts curves up the right side of frame; bale stack and blue barrels on the left verge. The car sits with a narrow gap between the two trunks ahead.
decision.hypothesis: The car is stalled in a tight pine gap just left of the lane. Plain forward throttle through the gap should keep it clear of both trunks and let it settle onto the tarmac.
decision.memory: Steering in this tight pine gap risks striking a trunk; prefer plain throttle when trunks flank the nose closely.
